_comment: Copy to sites.json and fill in. sites.json is gitignored: a management
token can read AND rewrite every story in its space.
One entry per site. AKUH, AKU and AKUEB are three separate Storyblok
spaces with three separate component libraries, and each backs up to its
own repo — nothing is shared between them.
name              the site. Also selects the environment variable that
SB_TOKEN_AKUEB. Use those in CI so no token is on disk.
space_id          numeric, from Settings -> General in Storyblok.
management_token  a Personal Access Token (My Account -> Personal access
tokens). Space-level tokens 403 on several endpoints.
region            eu | us | ca | ap | cn. The wrong region returns a 401
that looks exactly like a bad token.
repo              local checkout of THIS site's backup repo. It is created
and 'git init'ed if absent — but clone the empty GitHub
repo here first and the origin remote is already set.
